enable_autostart.description: Enable/disable autostart of all Ayatana indicators at session login. Based on typical .desktop autostart behavior documented in ayatana-settings(8).

enabled_indicators.description: List of indicator services to enable by default. Corresponds to standard Ayatana System Indicators documented in ayatana-settings(8) description (sound, session, messages, datetime).

disabled_indicators.description: List of indicator services to explicitly disable. Based on the ability to fine-tune indicator behavior via ayatana-settings GUI.

icon_theme.description: Icon theme name to use for indicators. Maps to standard icon theme configuration; 'hicolor' is the fallback theme defined in the icon theme spec.

session_show_logout.description: Show logout option in session indicator menu. Based on session management indicators described in ayatana-settings(8).

session_show_lock.description: Show lock screen option in session indicator menu.

session_show_restart.description: Show restart option in session indicator menu. Default false per typical security/practicality guidance.

session_show_shutdown.description: Show shutdown option in session indicator menu. Default false per typical security/practicality guidance.

message_show_bubble.description: Enable message notification bubbles in the message indicator.

message_check_interval.description: Interval (seconds) for checking new messages in the message indicator. Based on realistic polling frequency.
